Headquarters: Remote, United States

General Counsel

Remote, United States

Company Overview

Legion Technologies is the pioneer in AI-powered workforce management. Our SaaS platform helps large, distributed enterprises maximize labor efficiency while improving the experience of hourly employees through AI-driven demand forecasting, automated scheduling, time & attendance, and employee engagement tools.(Legion)

Our mission is to transform hourly jobs into good jobs by giving businesses intelligent automation and employees greater flexibility, transparency, and control via an easy-to-use mobile app.(Legion)

Role Summary

The General Counsel (“GC”) is the chief legal officer of Legion Technologies and a key member of the executive leadership team. This role is responsible for:

• Leading Legion’s global legal, intellectual property, and corporate functions

• Serving as a strategic partner to the CEO, executive team, and Board of Directors

• Building and scaling a high-performing legal organization that supports Legion’s next phase of growth, globalization, and product innovation

The GC will own the company’s overall legal strategy across commercial/SaaS, privacy and data protection, AI governance, labor and employment, corporate governance, IP, regulatory compliance, and risk management.(Legion)

Key Responsibilities

1. Legal Strategy & Leadership

• Develop and execute a comprehensive legal strategy that aligns with Legion’s business objectives and growth plans in AI-powered workforce management.

• Advise the CEO, executive team, and Board on key legal, regulatory, and governance matters, including risk, compliance, fundraising, and strategic transactions.

• Build, lead, and mentor a high-performing in-house legal team; manage external counsel efficiently across specialties and jurisdictions.
Establish scalable processes, templates, and playbooks to support rapid go-to-market and partnership execution.

2. Corporate Governance & Financing

• Serve as corporate secretary for Legion Technologies and its subsidiaries; manage all Board and committee governance processes, including agendas, materials, minutes, and consents.

• Oversee corporate structure, subsidiary management, and global entity compliance.

• Support equity and debt financings, including negotiations with investors, diligence, and ongoing compliance with investor rights and governance frameworks.

• Partner with Finance and People teams on equity plan administration, stock option programs, and related disclosures.

3. Commercial, Product & Partnership Counsel

• Own legal support for Legion’s commercial operations, including:

• Enterprise SaaS subscriptions and professional services agreements

• Channel, OEM, marketplace, and strategic partner agreements

• Data processing, DPA, and information security terms

• Work closely with Sales, Customer Success, and Partnerships to enable predictable deal cycles while appropriately managing risk.

• Partner with Product, Engineering, and Security to ensure Legion’s AI-enabled WFM platform, APIs, and integrations with partners (e.g., SAP SuccessFactors and other HR platforms) comply with applicable laws, industry standards, and customer requirements.

• Provide practical, business-oriented product counseling on new features, AI use cases, mobile app capabilities, and international expansion.

4. Privacy, Data Protection & Terms of Use

• Own Legion’s global privacy and data protection program, including compliance with U.S. federal and state laws (e.g., CCPA/CPRA) and international frameworks where applicable.

• Oversee Legion’s Terms of Service, privacy policy, and related product policies, ensuring they remain up to date with evolving regulatory requirements and product capabilities.

• Work with Security and IT to support customer security reviews, audits, and incident response readiness.
Develop and maintain policies and training related to data governance, acceptable use, and ethical AI usage within the platform.

5. Labor, Employment & Workforce Compliance

• Advise on employment matters across Legion’s workforce, including hiring, terminations, performance management, compensation, and incentive programs.

• Support the People team in implementing policies that are compliant with applicable labor laws and consistent with Legion’s mission to improve hourly workers’ experience.

• Provide guidance on product features designed to support customers’ compliance with labor and scheduling laws (e.g., predictable scheduling, good faith estimates, overtime rules), in partnership with Product and Customer Success.

6. Intellectual Property & Innovation

• Develop and implement Legion’s global IP strategy, including patents, trademarks, copyrights, trade secrets, and open-source usage.

• Partner with Product and Engineering to identify and protect innovations related to AI models, algorithms, data pipelines, and workforce management solutions.
Manage enforcement and defense of Legion’s IP rights and respond to third-party claims.

7. Regulatory, Compliance & Risk Management

• Identify and monitor evolving legal and regulatory developments affecting:

• AI and machine learning

• Data privacy and security

• Employment and labor laws

• Enterprise software and cloud services

• Design and oversee a risk and compliance framework that includes policies, training, internal controls, and reporting.

• Support internal investigations and compliance reviews; partner with HR and other functions on ethics and integrity initiatives.

• Coordinate with insurers and brokers on appropriate coverage (e.g., E&O, cyber, D&O) and manage claims as needed.

8. Strategic Transactions & Corporate Development

• Lead legal aspects of M&A, investments, and strategic partnerships, from diligence and transaction negotiation through integration.
Provide structured guidance on competition, antitrust, and other regulatory considerations for strategic deals.

Qualifications

Required

• J.D. degree from an accredited law school and membership in good standing with at least one U.S. state bar.

• 15+ years of combined experience in top-tier law firm and in-house roles, with significant time as General Counsel, Chief Legal Officer, or senior deputy GC at a high-growth technology or SaaS company.

• Deep experience advising on:

• Enterprise SaaS and commercial contracting

• Corporate governance and venture-backed/private equity-backed company issues

• Data privacy and security

• IP strategy and licensing

• Demonstrated track record of building and leading legal teams that support rapid growth and international expansion.

• Proven ability to operate as a business-minded advisor, balancing risk with strategic and commercial objectives.

Preferred Qualification

• Experience in HR tech, workforce management, fintech, or other data-intensive SaaS businesses.

• Prior leadership supporting AI/ML products and associated ethical, regulatory, and data governance issues.

• Experience supporting global customers and operations across North America, EMEA, and APAC.

Prior work with large enterprise and strategic partners (e.g., SAP, other HCM vendors).

Skills & Attributes

• Exceptional judgment, integrity, and discretion; trusted partner to executives and Board.

• Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate complex legal issues into clear, actionable guidance for non-legal stakeholders.

• Highly collaborative, low-ego leadership style with a focus on enabling the business.

• Bias toward practicality and speed; comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

Passion for Legion’s mission to transform hourly jobs and improve the experience of frontline workers.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

• This is a full-time, exempt position.

• Some travel may be required to meet with customers, partners, investors, regulators, and internal teams.

• Legion offers a competitive compensation package including salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits. …

0d69747e3eab0ddd.description: About the Company: Ruder Finn is seeking a Senior Data Analyst (Data Analyst III) to join its award-winning Emerging Technology & Analytics team. The chosen candidate will support the agencys current business efforts by spearheading the research activities such as but not limited to earned media analysis, social listening, influencer identification, data modeling and predictive analytics. This individual will collaborate with several account teams within the agency providing counsel as needed on the various research and analytics needs of the agencys clients. As Data Analyst III, you will have the opportunity to work alongside the Chief Technology Officer based in New York, NY, on several innovative Consumer, Technology, and Healthcare-related client accounts. The ideal candidate would be a digital native with deep expertise in and a passion for data visualization and storytelling, statistics, web analytics, social media analytics, and the ability to connect the dots back to business objectives. This position will be fully remote, and the working hours will be either 6:00 pm 3:30 am IST / 8:30 am 6:00 pm ET or 2:00 pm 11:00 pm IST / 4:30 am 1:30 pm ET. Ultimately, your work will help define the business strategy for projects and clients and play a significant role in the growth of the agency. About the Role: If you are motivated by complex, purposeful challenges, this role, with one of the world's largest independent PR and Comms agencies, could be the fit you have been looking for! Job Responsibilities: - Collaborate with the global Emerging Technology & Analytics team colleagues in research projects pertaining to new business or client mandates involving sourcing, analysis, and reporting of data and insights tied to the concerned business objectives - Deliver market and audience intelligence, including social and digital landscape analysis, audience behavior analysis, sentiment analysis, keyword research, search performance, and competitor analysis including but not limited to share of voice and message pull through - Build measurement frameworks, set up searches and dashboards using Boolean queries, and develop client-facing insights and reports Qualifications: - Bachelor's Degree in business analytics, computer science, marketing, psychology, or advertising preferred - A minimum of 4 years of agency or in-house experience in a data or research analyst role - Experience and expertise with writing complex Boolean queries and operating data and media analytics tools such as Cision, Brandwatch, Rival IQ, Meltwater, Signal AI, etc. - Expertise in Excel, Google Sheets, Google Analytics and one or more contemporary data visualization platforms (e.g.: Tableau, Power BI, Google Data Studio, etc.) along with SQL - Proficiency in AWS, Python, R, and any other statistical computing or functional programming language is a major plus - Experience with data modeling and developing custom models is a plus - Experience with custom LLMs and working with the contemporary LLMs (e.g. ChatGPT, Bard, etc.) is a plus - Excellent problem-solving, creative thinking, general modeling, and data processing skills - Strong project management skills, self-starter, ability to adapt and multi-task, and a proven track record of delivering quality and accurate results in a fast-paced and high efficiency agency environment - Extremely strong verbal and written English language communication skills .

Job Description

You are a strategic thinker passionate about driving solutions in Equity Research . You have found the right team.

As an " Equity Research Professional” within our dynamic team, you will be responsible for setting and improving our organizational objectives, and ensuring their consistent accomplishment.

Job Responsibilities

• Track companies within the European Technology space.
• Build and maintain financial models to support investment valuation, leveraging advanced Excel and modeling skills.
• Develop financial forecasts under direction of the Senior Research Analyst and Portfolio Managers.
• Perform relative value comparisons across European Tech companies and peers.
• Support coverage initiation by assisting the Senior Research Analyst with analysis and investment materials.
• Generate timely macroeconomic, political, and company insights relevant to the sector and covered names.
• Identify new investment ideas and opportunities within the coverage universe.
• Evaluate existing investments through ongoing fundamental analysis, valuation work, and coverage maintenance.
• Manage interactions with company management teams and sell-side analysts as part of the research process.
• Collaborate and communicate with a global network of JPMorganChase Asset Management Technology analysts.
• Demonstrate intellectual curiosity, intellectual honesty, measured investment judgment, and proactive teamwork in day-to-day execution.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills

• Hold a post graduate degree.
• Bring at least 3 years of relevant investment experience.
• Apply strong analytical skills and sound decision-making to investment research.
• Exhibit measured investment judgment, intellectual curiosity, and intellectual honesty.
• Communicate proactively and work effectively in a team environment.
• Operate in an EMEA shift schedule (1:30pm to 10:30pm).
• Sustain high motivation and a strong work ethic in a demanding research role.

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills

• Possess a CFA (preferred).
• Demonstrate prior Equity Research experience (preferred, ideally covering the Technology sector).

Morgan and Chase brands. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

About The Team

J.P. Morgan Asset & Wealth Management delivers industry-leading investment management and private banking solutions. Asset Management provides individuals, advisors and institutions with strategies and expertise that span the full spectrum of asset classes through our global network of investment professionals. Wealth Management helps individuals, families and foundations take a more intentional approach to their wealth or finances to better define, focus and realize their goals.

Financial Analyst II

ICON is a global healthcare intelligence and clinical research organisation united by a mission to bring new medicines and treatments to patients faster.

As a values-driven organisation, integrity, collaboration, agility, and inclusion are at the heart of how we work and interact with each other, customers, patients and suppliers.

As a Financial Analyst II at ICON, you will play a significant role in supporting advanced financial planning, analysis, and decision-making processes.

What You Will Do

Your role will involve delivering finance and financial management work to a high standard, working closely with your team and stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities Include

• Conducting detailed financial analysis, including variance analysis, forecasting, and budgeting, to support business unit performance and strategic planning.
• Developing and maintaining complex financial models to evaluate business scenarios and support decision-making processes.
• Collaborating with cross-functional teams to monitor and report on key financial and operational metrics.
• Assisting in the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports, ensuring accuracy and compliance with internal and external requirements.
• Identifying opportunities for process improvements and implementing best practices in financial analysis and reporting.

Your Profile

You will bring relevant finance and financial management experience, along with the following qualifications and skills.

Required Qualifications And Experience

• Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, business administration, or a related discipline
• 2-4 years of experience in financial analysis or related roles, with a strong understanding of financial principles and practices.
• Advanced proficiency in financial modeling and analytical tools, such as Excel, with experience in financial software (e.g., SAP, Oracle) being a plus.
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a high level of attention to detail and accuracy.
• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with diverse teams and stakeholders.
• Willingness to travel as required (approximately 5%)

What ICON Can Offer You

Our success depends on the quality of our people. That’s why we’ve made it a priority to build a diverse culture that rewards high performance and nurtures talent.

In addition to your competitive salary, ICON offers a range of additional benefits. Our benefits are designed to be competitive within each country and are focused on well-being and work life balance opportunities for you and your family.

Our Benefits Examples Include

• Various annual leave entitlements 
• A range of health insurance offerings to suit you and your family’s needs. 
• Competitive retirement planning offerings to maximize savings and plan with confidence for the years ahead. 
• Global Employee Assistance Programme, LifeWorks, offering 24-hour access to a global network of over 80,000 independent specialized professionals who are there to support you and your family’s well-being. 
• Life assurance 
• Flexible country-specific optional benefits, including childcare vouchers, bike purchase schemes, discounted gym memberships, subsidized travel passes, health assessments, among others. 

Visit our careers site to read more about the benefits ICON offers.

At ICON, inclusion & belonging are fundamental to our culture and values. We’re dedicated to providing an inclusive and accessible environment for all candidates. ICON is committed to providing a workplace free of discrimination and harassment. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, or in order to perform the essential functions of a position, please let us know or submit a request here
